decisions.reason: As a flagship organic salami line with several variants that has already remained in the assortment through 2024, it is tightly aligned with the firm's core curing, seasoning, and slicing know-how and its stated organic expansion path.

The product is still close enough to the firm's meat-snack and organic capabilities to be improved through routine market learning, though its narrower poultry mini-snack niche makes it somewhat more exposed to assortment pruning than the main salami lines.

This premium sharing salami line builds directly on the firm's established salami expertise and broad-variety strategy, so management would be more likely to refine formats or positioning than withdraw it quickly.

An organic boiled pork sausage is a very adjacent extension of the firm's traditional cooked-meat competencies and fits the organic portfolio build-out, which gives the firm strong ability to interpret demand and adjust rather than exit.

The organic thinly sliced chicken breast line extends existing slicing, seasoning, and premium cold-cut capabilities into a format consistent with ingredient-conscious demand, and its multiple variants improve the chances of learning and retention.

Organic herb-coated salami remains close to the firm's salami base and seasoning strengths, but as a more specific flavor-led variant without the same flagship role or visible line breadth, it faces a somewhat higher review risk than the core organic ranges.
